_note: Evidence quality describes how much and how good the available data is. It is NOT a model confidence and says nothing about whether the risk classification is correct.

product_profiles._note: Freshness and observation-count expectations depend on the satellite product. MOD13Q1 is a 16-day composite published with a production delay of roughly 1-3 weeks after the composite period ends, so a composite start date ~32 days old is the newest data normally obtainable. The default profile reflects ~5-day Sentinel-2 revisits.
